title: Econ Catalyst: Initiative Tracking for Adaptive Cost Controls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver an initiative-level tracker and execution plan for an adaptive cost-control playbook that orchestrates batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization profiles to reduce per-token serving cost while preserving >=98% of customer-facing output quality for primary workloads. Scope includes hypothesis catalog, prioritized experiments, guardrails for regressions, rollout cadence, and handoff to ops for automated rollout. This ticket captures the PM roadmap, OKRs, milestone plan, and cross-functional coordination notes.
acceptance_criteria: Centralized initiative tracker in Linear with clear milestones and owners
Hypothesis registry with prioritized experiments for batching, cache, quant profiles
Three field experiments (canary, rollout, rollback) defined with success metrics
Integration with Console observability dashboards for ROI metrics (cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95 latency)
Rollout playbook and rollback criteria documented and reviewed by SRE/ML infra
milestones: M2: Experiment harness and telemetry hooks — 2025-02-14
M4: Gradual rollout to 50% with automated rollback gating — 2025-03-20
metrics: Primary: net cost reduction per 1M tokens served (target >= 18% reduction)
Quality guardrail: model output match rate on golden prompt set (>=98%)
Reliability: no increase in 99th percentile error rate beyond 0.2%
Performance: p95 latency change within +50ms of baseline for latency-sensitive tiers
risks: Quality regressions from aggressive quantization on edge prompts
Increased latency from larger batching windows for low-concurrency customers
Rollback complexity if KV cache TTL interacts poorly with multi-tenant workloads
Telemetry gaps: cost attribution per-feature not yet wired in older routes
